passages.text: “Mendicants, those sentient beings who do good things in the morning by way of body, speech, and mind have a good morning. Those sentient beings who do good things at midday by way of body, speech, and mind have a good midday. Those sentient beings who do good things in the evening by way of body, speech, and mind have a good evening.
passages.note: a good day is made by good actions
